title: Mycorena Files for Bankruptcy, Seeks New Ownership to Continue Pioneering Mycoprotein Ingredients

findings.claim: Swedish mycoprotein producer Mycorena filed for bankruptcy after significant financial challenges; aims to restructure under new ownership
Mycorena raised over EUR 35 million in funding, incl EUR 24 million described as largest-ever Nordic Series A round
Paused construction of a large-scale facility and pivoted business model prior to filing
Magnus Lofving (Advokatfirman Lindahl KB) appointed trustee; assets incl patents and trademarks offered to bidders
Gothenburg demo facility said to produce enough mycoprotein to supply up to 500 tons of end-consumer products

notMeasured: precise filing date (Green Queen gives ~13 Jul 2024)
limitations: Trade/advocacy outlet reproducing company statements; figures are company-provided, not audited.

title: Mycorena CEO on Filing for Bankruptcy: 'It's the Most Viable Path for A Clean Restart'

findings.claim: Mycorena filed for bankruptcy after unsuccessful Series B fundraise, one month after discontinuing commercial-scale factory plans; a consortium of former shareholders aims to buy back the estate
Mycorena has raised over EUR 35M in equity funding; operates a Gothenburg demonstration facility opened 2021
In 2023 investment in food tech startups declined by 61%, and alternative proteins took a 44% hit (outlet's figures)
CEO cites offtake 'catch-22', diminished investor appetite for large capex alt-protein projects, and slower-than-expected European alt-protein market growth as failure causes

limitations: Interview-based; market stats attributed to outlet's own reporting; retail-sales figures elsewhere in article ($28M->$29M) appear mislabeled in units and were not extracted as findings.

title: Swedish foodtech startup restructures through acquisition after bankruptcy filing (Mycorena acquired by Naplasol)

findings.claim: Mycorena acquired by Naplasol, part of the VEOS Group (Belgium), allowing scale-up on Naplasol's industrial infrastructure
Mycorena AB filed for bankruptcy on July 10th (2024), citing insurmountable financial challenges and difficulty securing lead investors
Assets transferred include robust patent portfolio and advanced production facilities; VEOS co-CEO Wim Slee and founder Ramkumar Nair quoted

limitations: Startup-news outlet; acquisition terms not disclosed.

title: DUG Foodtech Declared Bankrupt, Assets Now Open for Acquisition

findings.claim: DUG Foodtech AB (formerly Veg of Lund), a potato-based dairy alternative maker, entered bankruptcy by Lund District Court ruling on 19 December 2025 at its own request after failing to secure financing
Nasdaq Stockholm delisted the shares from the First North Growth Market
Share price fell by nearly 78% over the past year, and more than 99% over the past five years
Trustee Ann-Christine Halen (Ackordscentralen Syd AB) appointed; assets offered via tender with bid deadline 22 January 2026; rebranded from Veg of Lund mid-2024

limitations: Trade outlet; share-price percentages company/market-reported, not independently verified here.

title: Swedish Plant-Based Meat Startup Hooked Foods Calls It Quits Amid Sector Slowdown

findings.claim: Stockholm-based Hooked Foods (vegan seafood/chicken) declared bankruptcy and shut down after running out of cash, less than a year after its latest fundraise
Founded 2019 by Tom Johansson, Emil Wasteson, Peter Liu; products in ~500 retail stores in Sweden plus German supermarkets, 7-Eleven and kebab-chain partnerships
Raised 8.4 million kronor (~$830,000) for AI investment, taking total funding past $6M
A Portuguese manufacturing partner went bankrupt, affecting production for a third of the year; a new German distributor also announced closure

limitations: Trade outlet citing CEO social-media statement and Breakit interview.

title: Mycorena - Products, Competitors, Financials, Employees, Headquarters Locations

findings.claim: Mycorena total raised $38.55M; founded 2017; HQ Gothenburg; in July 2024 filed for bankruptcy; current stage 'Asset Sale / Assets Purchased'
Investors listed include Naplasol, European Space Agency, FFG, Vinnova and 13 more; 2 patents filed; competitors incl Enifer

limitations: Aggregator profile; funding total ($38.55M) differs from media's 'over EUR 35M' framing; figures not independently audited.

title: ENORM BioFactory A/S - erhvervsbasen profil og pressetidslinje

findings.claim: ENORM BioFactory A/S (CVR 38847147), described as Northern Europe's largest insect factory (protein production), went bankrupt

A Euro Steel subsidiary (steel group) acquired the bankrupt insect factory and farmland near Hedensted for just under DKK 66 million; proceeds cover only a fraction of total claims, leaving creditors with significant losses
findings.systemBoundary: salgssum for fabrikk + landbruksjord; ikke totale krav i boet

limitations: Aggregator of press headlines/summaries behind partial paywall; figures are media-reported, not from primary court/registry documents.

title: Dansk Landbrugs Grovvareselskab (DLG) - erhvervsbasen; Enorm-konkurs tab

findings.claim: DLG (Dansk Landbrugs Grovvareselskab, CVR 24246930, owned by 25,000 Danish farmers) lost roughly DKK 70 million when insect factory Enorm Biofactory in Hvirring went bankrupt last year; DLG says it will invest closer to core business ('slut med umodne projekter')
findings.locator: overskrift 'DLG gor millionregningen op efter Enorm-konkurs'

findings.claim: DLG imports around 900,000 tons of soy per year (context on DLG's scale)

limitations: Aggregator of press summaries; DKK 70M is a rounded, media-reported figure.

title: Interim-CFO gaat Noorse vertical farm helpen met herstructurering (Gront fra Nord)

findings.claim: Gront fra Nord AS, a Norwegian vertical farm that recently obtained court permission to restructure, appointed Mads Pinnerod as interim CFO (via his advisory firm Emiro AS) as it enters the post-restructuring phase

Founder/CEO Marius Johansen cites regional demand, food security and regional value-creation in Northern Norway as long-term driver; CFO focus on cost control, cashflow and reporting for future investment

limitations: Horticulture trade outlet (Dutch); reports company appointment/statements only.

title: Fra konkurstruet til optimistisk (Gront fra Nord)

findings.claim: Intro only: Gront fra Nord (salad factory) produced minimally for several months, furloughed employees and was bankruptcy-threatened; now signs point to it continuing with increased strength (Marius Johansen)

limitations: Paywalled local paper ('Kjop abonnement for a fa tilgang'); only headline, byline and intro retrievable.

title: Industry Consolidation: 40+ Major Alternative Protein Companies Have Shut or Been Acquired in Past Year

findings.claim: Between 1 Sep 2024 and 31 Aug 2025, more than 40 major alternative protein ventures shut down, merged, went bankrupt/into liquidation, or were acquired (Green Queen's own tally)
findings.locator: paras under 'Alt Protein Sector M&A Activity'

findings.claim: Geographic split: Europe 23 deals, North America 16, Asia-Pacific 5
By technology: plant-based 32, fermentation 7, cell cultivation 3, molecular farming 1, blended protein 1
By deal type: acquisitions 24, closures 11, liquidations 4, bankruptcies 2, mergers 1 (plus asset sales); meat analogues 18 and dairy alternatives 10 most affected
findings.systemBoundary: Green Queens klassifisering; ekskl. senere oppkjopte/nedlagte fra likvid.-tall

limitations: Outlet's own research/tally, self-described as estimates; 'major' is undefined; not a peer-reviewed dataset.

konkurs status of the correct entity
